title: Improperly documented default value for `graphroot=` / rootless podman 6: `mkdir /var/lib/containers/storage/libpod: permission denied`
body:
```
$ sudo podman version
Client:       Podman Engine
Version:      6.0.3-dev
API Version:  6.0.3-dev
Go Version:   go1.26.6-X:nodwarf5
Git Commit:   86216e553db8f2a461ae7aa1b0797e502d625f11
Built:        Sun Aug 23 10:25:50 2026
OS/Arch:      linux/amd64
```
Why rootless fails?
```
$ podman version
Error: creating runtime static files directory "/var/lib/containers/storage/libpod": mkdir /var/lib/containers/storage/libpod: permission denied
```

comments.body:
v6.0.2 also fails:
```
$ sudo podman version
Client:       Podman Engine
Version:      6.0.2
API Version:  6.0.2
Go Version:   go1.26.6-X:nodwarf5
Git Commit:   b28edb9ad70ce4317dc762ee9ce0a6d081d154e9
Built:        Sun Aug 23 20:16:43 2026
OS/Arch:      linux/amd64

$ podman version
Error: creating runtime static files directory "/var/lib/containers/storage/libpod": mkdir /var/lib/containers/storage/libpod: permission denied
```
v6.1 branch fails:
```
$ sudo podman version
Client:       Podman Engine
Version:      6.1.1-dev
API Version:  6.1.1-dev
Go Version:   go1.26.6-X:nodwarf5
Git Commit:   45c0f70e979bf04c1cf6f4480d4ecf6aa6159a01
Built:        Sun Aug 23 20:20:37 2026
OS/Arch:      linux/amd64

$ podman version
Error: creating runtime static files directory "/var/lib/containers/storage/libpod": mkdir /var/lib/containers/storage/libpod: permission denied
```
Rootless 5.8 works:
```
$ podman version
Client:       Podman Engine
Version:      5.8.7-dev
API Version:  5.8.7-dev
Go Version:   go1.26.6-X:nodwarf5
Git Commit:   8b0be50399cd71d6155be139cfc5c8b418886fe6
Built:        Sun Aug 23 20:26:49 2026
OS/Arch:      linux/amd64

```

I solved this by removing `graphroot = "/var/lib/containers/storage"` from `/etc/containers/storage.conf`:
```
$ podman version
Client:       Podman Engine
Version:      6.1.1-dev
API Version:  6.1.1-dev
Go Version:   go1.26.6-X:nodwarf5
Git Commit:   45c0f70e979bf04c1cf6f4480d4ecf6aa6159a01
Built:        Sun Aug 23 20:42:37 2026
OS/Arch:      linux/amd64

```

The text at https://github.com/containers/storage/blob/main/docs/containers-storage.conf.5.md is:

> graphroot="" container storage graph dir (default: "/var/lib/containers/storage") Default directory to store all writable content created by container storage programs. The rootless graphroot path supports environment variable substitutions (ie. $HOME/containers/storage). 

My reading is, that there should be no difference, when `graphroot=` is not set in `/etc/containers/storage.conf` - as then the default value applies for rootless podman - and when is set `graphroot="/var/lib/containers/storage"`.  But there is a difference.

Why don’t I have permissions to reopen this issue?
